name: Gran Melia Villa Agrippina
positioning: Villa Agrippina Gran Melia, a Leading Hotels of the World member in Rome between the Vatican and Trastevere, built on the ruins of an ancient Roman villa
best_for: Travelers who want a base between the Vatican and Trastevere
Families who want kids' amenities, a children's cooking class and a summer pool
Food lovers interested in chef Alfonso D'Auria's Italian cooking at Follie

facts.text: The hotel is located between the Vatican and the Trastevere district.
The hotel is named after the first Roman empress.
Villa Agrippina Gran Melia is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
Follie, the hotel's fine-dining restaurant, serves Italian classics with a contemporary twist by chef Alfonso D'Auria.
Chef Alfonso D'Auria blends Mediterranean cooking with the culinary style of his Campania roots.
Amaro hosts a Roman-style Sunday brunch.
Amaro is a cocktail bar with live music.
The spa uses Clarins and My Blend treatments.
The gym has TechnoGym equipment, and a personal trainer is available on request.
Family amenities include baby cots, bed guards, bottle warmers, prams and strollers.
The family cooking class with the hotel's chef is for children aged 6 to 12 accompanied by an adult.
The hotel is pet-friendly, with a pet service available for pets up to 10 kg.

highlights.text: The hotel is built on the ruins of an ancient Roman villa.
The hotel has views of Castel Sant'Angelo and the Tiber River.
The spa has a sauna, a steam room with chromo-aromatherapy, sensory showers and an outdoor vitality pool with Jacuzzi.
Gala serves classic cuisine in a light format at the pool, surrounded by lemon, strawberry and olive trees.
The Supreme Room with Whirlpool has a private terrace with views of the Vatican Dome from an outdoor whirlpool bathtub.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is not heated and is open seasonally from May to September.
The one-hour spa wellness circuit comes with a spa treatment reservation.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
